source.note: Scores are official NFL.com finals. One Week 2 game is rendered 'Hidden Score' on the official page and is left blank, never inferred.

league.note: A total line needs the mean and sd of the combined score; a spread needs the mean and sd of the margin. These are estimated from official finals only. They describe the past nine weeks and carry no market comparison.

model_all.form: home = mu + hfa/2 + attack[home] - defence[away]; away = mu - hfa/2 + attack[away] - defence[home]

model_fit.note: Residual sd of the margin is the number a spread's uncertainty band needs. It is estimated in sample, so it is optimistic.

reliability.method: Split the nine weeks into odd and even weeks, re-fit team ratings independently, correlate the implied net team strength. Spearman-Brown corrects the half-sample correlation to the full nine-week scale.
reliability.caveat: A nine-week, single-season sample is small. The reliability figure bounds how much of an early-season team rating can be trusted; it does not make the rating predictive and it is not a market edge.

correlations.use: Sets whether a spread signal and a total signal can be treated as independent when combining legs. This is measured; prop-to-prop correlation is not, because no prop outcome data exists in this repository.

correlations.pair: Team margin in week w vs week w+1 (week-to-week persistence)
correlations.use: If week-to-week persistence is near zero, single-week streak or 'hot team' signals are noise and must not be promoted to a strategy.

correlations.pair: Team points scored vs points allowed (32 teams, whole sample)
correlations.use: Measured, not assumed. If scoring and conceding are strongly positively related, pace is a shared factor and affects how a team total and a game total move together.

UNKNOWN - BLANK. No player-level outcome data exists in this repository, so no prop correlation can be stated. Any number here would be fabricated. It must be measured from official box scores before a prop-combination strategy may pass a gate.

walk_forward.sigma_used_note: sigma is re-estimated inside each walk-forward step from prior weeks only
walk_forward.verdict: Computed out of sample with no tuning on evaluation weeks. Even a positive number here is a winner-probability skill, not a betting edge: no price, no vig, no closing line and no settlement archive exist in this repository.

luck.method: For every team, actual wins are compared with (a) the wins the fitted opponent-adjusted ratings expected before those games and (b) a Pythagorean point-differential estimate. All inputs are official finals.

teams.note: expected_wins_from_ratings is the win total the opponent-adjusted ratings predicted before those games; wins minus that total is the unexplained residual (candidate luck or clutch performance, not proof of either). pythagorean_wins uses the conventional 2.37 exponent, which is an assumption and is labelled as one.

luck.summary: Reported because 'removing luck' is a request the data can only partly satisfy. What the data supports is measuring (a) how much of a rating repeats, (b) how far a team's record sits from its point differential, and (c) whether skill survives out of sample. Luck itself is never removed.

origination.method: Independent numbers, not copies of any market. Spread = opponent-adjusted net rating difference plus estimated home-field advantage. Total = fitted league total, which is constant by construction for every game - a documented limitation of a points-only model.
origination.status: SHADOW ONLY. No originated number in this table has been compared with a market price, so no edge, no value and no closing-line advantage is claimed or measurable here.

limitations: Nine weeks of one season, 135 usable finals: wide uncertainty on every estimate.
No injury adjustment: ratings ignore who was actually available.
No market prices anywhere in the repository, so edge, vig and CLV are UNKNOWN and blank.
No player-level outcomes, so prop and parlay-leg correlations are UNKNOWN and blank.
A constant total for every game is a model limitation, not a claim about any matchup.
The one hidden-score game is excluded rather than estimated.
Home-field advantage is estimated here at essentially zero for this sample. That is a sample property of 2026 Weeks 1-9 and must not be generalised into a prior without more seasons.
